verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a catalog of 100+ supported models with instant access to popular OSS models. Its shared Serverless tier lets you point at api.fireworks.ai and pay per token, with no GPUs to size, and it serves leading open-source text models through OpenAI-compatible APIs. Missing for 10: no evidence naming the specific families on serverless (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS), no list showing how current the catalog is, and no independent hands-on corroboration of catalog breadth.
